lines: One-staff he having known, trident sky-going, dear; having bound but Khecarī mudrā, having meditated self and Bhairava.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ekadaṇḍaṃ sa vijñāya triśūlaṃ khacaraṃ priye baddhvā tu khecarīṃ mudrāṃ dhyātvātmānaṃ ca bhairavam
